chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Ismail ibn Mihran, from Munzir ibn Ja'far, from Adam Abu al-Husayn al-Lu'lu'i, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

The believer is the one whose earnings are good, his character is excellent, his inner self is sound, he spends the surplus of his wealth, he restrains the surplus of his speech, he spares people from his evil, and he does justice to people from himself.

key_terms.صَحَّتْ سَرِيرَتُهُ: His inner self/conscience is sound and consistent
key_terms.طَابَ مَكْسَبُهُ: His earnings/provision are pure and lawful
key_terms.كَفَى النَّاسَ شَرَّهُ: He spares people from his evil/harm

ai.seo_question: What are the key signs and characteristics of a true believer according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, Shaykh al-Kulayni presents this hadith as a comprehensive definition of the believer, linking external conduct (makasib, khaliqa) with internal state (sarira). It highlights the Shia emphasis on balancing spiritual purity with social ethics, where the believer actively protects others from harm and practices self-restraint in speech and wealth. This narrative serves as a practical guide for moral development, reflecting the Imams' focus on character as the visible manifestation of faith.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Ismail Bin Mihran, from Munzir Bin Ja’far, from Adam Bin Abu Al Husayn Al Lu’lui, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘

The Momin is the one whose earnings are good (not unlawful), and his mannerisms are excellent, and his conscience is correct, and he spends from the excess of his wealth and withholds from the excess of his words, and the people are spared from his evil, and he dispenses justice to the people from himself’.
en.sarwar: 18. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid from Isma’il ibn Mehran from Mundhar ibn Jayfar from Adam abu al-Husayn al- LuTu’i from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “

A believer is one whose earning is pleasantly clean, whose moral behavior is excellent and whose conscience is not ill. He gives to charity the extra from his property and holds back the extra of his words. People do not feel threatened by his evil and he yields to justice for people against his own soul.”
